build_cmlm_transformer_model: build a CMLMNATransformerModel for constant-time machine translation with conditional masked language models
run_forward_pass: run the forward pass of CMLMNATransformerModel to encode source tokens and predict word insertions and length
run_skeptical_decoding: run skeptical decoding in forward_decoder to iteratively unmask tokens using skeptical unmasking strategy
review_skeptical_unmasking: review the _skeptical_unmasking function that computes a skeptical mask based on output scores and boundary length
configure_cmlm_architecture: configure the cmlm_base_architecture with encoder and decoder hyperparameters for the CMLM transformer model
